summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the sulphur/sulphuric-acid chokepoint with a two-lane structure. Reference lane includes obvious public companies tied to copper smelter-acid and phosphate fertilizer acid demand. Underfollowed lane emphasizes smaller or less commonly framed names where acid production, distribution, or project-specific acid optionality could matter if the 2026 sulphur/acid logistics shock persists. This is a research universe only, not a buy/sell list.
